headline: Emami, HUL, and CAMS among companies trading ex-dividend this week
hook: Eight dividend payouts scheduled for this week
summary: Several prominent listed companies including Emami, Chambal Fertilisers, Hindustan Unilever, CAMS, GE Shipping, Star Cement, and Shivalik Bimetal are scheduled to trade ex-dividend this week. Shareholders owning the stock as of the record date will be eligible for the respective payouts. For retail investors holding these names, the dividend payouts offer cash returns, though share prices typically adjust downward on the ex-date by the dividend amount.
whats_next: Upcoming ex-dividend dates for the listed stocks
why_it_matters: Check ex-dates to ensure eligibility for upcoming dividend payouts.

headline: Axis Direct names 10 stocks with up to 48 percent upside for Samvat 2083
summary: Axis Direct has selected ten technical stocks for Diwali and Samvat 2083, projecting up to 48 percent upside potential based on long-term performance charts. The recommended portfolio includes Aurobindo Pharma, Hindustan Aeronautics, IOL Chemicals, Jyoti CNC Automation, Karnataka Bank, Dr. Lal Path Labs, Mayur Uniquoters, and Shivalik Bimetal Controls. These selections highlight technical strength and growth prospects for the coming year. Indian retail investors tracking festive brokerage picks can evaluate these names for potential portfolio additions.
why_it_matters: New brokerage recommendations to consider for festive portfolio additions.

headline: Axis Direct releases Diwali stock picks with 48% upside potential
summary: Axis Direct has released a list of 12 technical stock picks for the upcoming Samvat 2083. The brokerage highlights Aurobindo Pharma, Hindustan Aeronautics, and IOL Chemicals for their growth prospects. Other featured stocks include Jyoti CNC Automation, Karnataka Bank, Dr. Lal Path Labs, Mayur Uniquoters, and Shivalik Bimetal Controls. These selections are based on long-term performance charts and technical analysis.
why_it_matters: Brokerage research may influence short-term retail buying interest in these stocks.
